projects.title: Radius — AWS IAM Threat Detection & Automated Response
projects.description: AWS Organizations-scale IAM threat detection platform with automated containment. Detects compromised credentials, calculates blast radius, and disables attackers in seconds.
highlights: 8 Lambda functions orchestrating detection, scoring, and response
7 detection rules covering privilege escalation, credential stuffing, and anomalous access patterns
Blast Radius Score algorithm quantifies potential damage before containment
Automated IAM user disabling and session revocation
projects.why: I built Radius because detection without response is just monitoring. I wanted systems that fight back.
projects.challenge: Designing a scoring system that balances false positive risk against containment speed. The Blast Radius algorithm had to be fast enough for real-time response but accurate enough to trust in production.

projects.title: AnomAI — AWS IAM Anomaly Detection & Incident Explanation
projects.description: AI-powered IAM anomaly detection pipeline. Ingests CloudTrail events, runs 6 anomaly detectors, and surfaces incidents via Flask dashboard with LLM-powered incident explanation.
highlights: S3-triggered Lambda pipeline processing raw CloudTrail → structured signals
6 anomaly detectors: unusual hours, new principal, permission creep, API velocity, geo anomaly, service abuse
SIEM-style dashboard with incident timeline and affected resources
LLM-powered Q&A translates technical findings for non-experts
16 IAM incidents surfaced across 120-day evaluation period
projects.why: I want IAM incidents to feel explainable—so even non-experts can ask the right questions fast.
projects.role: Capstone team lead — detection logic, AI integration, dashboard
projects.challenge: Balancing detection sensitivity with explainability. Each anomaly needed a clear 'why this is suspicious' narrative that an LLM could translate for analysts.

architecture.alt: Data flow: CloudTrail → S3 bucket → Lambda analyzer → DynamoDB → Flask API → Dashboard

projects.title: Security Group Auto-Remediation with AWS Config & Lambda
projects.description: Self-healing security pipeline that detects unauthorized Security Group changes and restores approved rules automatically. MTTD under 1 second, MTTR approximately 4 seconds.
highlights: AWS Config Rules detecting Security Group drift in near-real-time
Lambda function restoring approved inbound/outbound rules
SNS notifications with before/after rule comparison
Zero manual intervention required after deployment
projects.why: I built this to shrink the 'danger window' from minutes/hours down to near-immediate recovery, without relying on external tools.
projects.role: Solo builder — AWS Config rules, Lambda remediation, monitoring
projects.challenge: AWS Config evaluation latency varies. I had to design the Lambda function to handle concurrent invocations and avoid race conditions when multiple rules fired simultaneously.

architecture.alt: AWS Config Rule → Lambda → EC2 Security Group → SNS notification flow

projects.title: CloudTrail Event-Driven Monitoring & Alerting
projects.description: Native AWS monitoring pipeline analyzing CloudTrail logs to detect failed authentication attempts and sensitive configuration changes without external SIEM tools.
highlights: EventBridge rules filtering 40+ security-relevant API calls
Detection for failed console logins, MFA changes, IAM policy modifications
Cost-effective alternative to third-party SIEM for small teams
projects.why: I wanted to show that effective monitoring is achievable using AWS native capabilities—no expensive SIEM required.
projects.role: Solo builder — EventBridge rules, CloudWatch integration
projects.challenge: Filtering signal from noise. CloudTrail logs everything; the hard part was identifying which events actually indicate security incidents versus routine operations.

architecture.alt: CloudTrail → EventBridge → CloudWatch Alarms → SNS notification pipeline
